items.failure: 006 technical proof was treated as nearly sufficient despite visual rejection.
items.root_cause: Technical QA and visual QA were not separate gates.
items.reusable_rule: Technical PASS never implies visual PASS for a new design profile.
items.future_check: Require VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE=HUMAN_REQUIRED until profile is admitted.

items.failure: Cover was drawn from primitive geometric shapes and looked non-commercial.
items.root_cause: Cover art direction, artwork generation and typography/composition were collapsed into Codex improvisation.
items.reusable_rule: Commercial covers require 3 distinct concepts routed through specialized visual/design tooling and thumbnail comparison.
items.future_check: Reject single primitive-cover proof for commercial nonfiction.

items.failure: Interior visuals were generic arrows/boxes that restated prose.
items.root_cause: Visual admission asked whether a visual could be made, not whether it explained something better than prose.
items.reusable_rule: Visuals must be REQUIRED or USEFUL; DECORATIVE and REDUNDANT visuals do not enter production by default.
items.future_check: Every visual record must include admission verdict and explanatory payoff.

items.failure: Proof TOC used a fake subset rather than the real eight-chapter structure.
items.root_cause: Technical proof convenience overrode reader-facing plausibility.
items.reusable_rule: Representative proofs must show plausible production front matter and full TOC for the approved book structure.
items.future_check: TOC surface must contain all approved chapters unless proof scope explicitly excludes TOC.

items.failure: Reader-facing proof contained production labels and placeholder author identity.
items.root_cause: Artifact-state metadata leaked into reader surfaces.
items.reusable_rule: Proof artifacts may be marked in manifests, not on reader-facing pages/covers unless explicitly a watermark proof.
items.future_check: Scan rendered text for production-proof residue and placeholder author names.

items.failure: Default LaTeX output produced functional but not professional typography.
items.root_cause: Renderer validity was mistaken for editorial interior design.
items.reusable_rule: Interior design must start from a profile/template and include visual checks for hyphenation, paragraph color, headings, notes and TOC quality.
items.future_check: New profile requires human visual review contact sheet.

items.failure: Source/endnote system was technically promising but not clearly separated from design artifacts.
items.root_cause: Useful source normalization and rejected visual direction shared the same proof slice.
items.reusable_rule: Source registry/endnote seam is reusable; visual artifacts remain unapproved until human accepts design.
items.future_check: Project format_artifacts must not point at visually rejected outputs as approved artifacts.

items.failure: Book Factory repeatedly rediscovered front matter, proof surfaces and gates.
items.root_cause: Known-profile production playbook did not exist.
items.reusable_rule: Known-profile commercial nonfiction uses a fixed production playbook: profile compatibility, source/endnote, visual admission, cover concepts, interior proof, preflight, visual gate, full build.
items.future_check: Future compatible books must use the playbook before custom production work.

items.failure: Codex cost went into production-system reasoning that should become reusable machinery.
items.root_cause: Lessons were recorded as narrative audits but not failure-to-rule process memory.
items.reusable_rule: Every expensive acceptance-case correction must map to PROFILE, SKILL, PLAYBOOK, SCHEMA, QA, LESSON or DONOR_POLICY.
items.future_check: Retrospective must emit a machine-readable failure map.

items.failure: The production proof used a manually written contents list without final page numbers.
items.root_cause: Print navigation was treated as copy instead of an output of final pagination.
items.reusable_rule: Paperback TOC page numbers are generated from final pagination and automatically validated; Kindle source carries no print pagination.
items.future_check: Fail release-candidate status when any approved chapter lacks a final TOC page number or Kindle source contains print artifacts.

items.failure: Forced chapter starts exposed nearly empty preceding pages and stranded short transitions.
items.root_cause: Chapter break correctness was checked without whole-book page-rhythm inspection.
items.reusable_rule: Every chapter starts on a new page and a profile-level chapter-tail balance rule prevents orphaned short transitions; every page is reviewed in one contact sheet.
items.future_check: Flag blank pages, isolated headings and pre-chapter pages below the occupancy threshold.

items.failure: Default TeX line breaking hyphenated headings and produced visually frequent body hyphenation.
items.root_cause: Hyphenation was not separated by typographic role.
items.reusable_rule: Headings never hyphenate; body hyphenation remains enabled but constrained and measured.
items.future_check: Fail on heading hyphenation and report body line-end hyphenations per thousand words.

items.failure: Reader-facing Notes inherited internal source aliases and raw-path-oriented provenance language.
items.root_cause: Internal research traceability and publication bibliography were rendered from the same labels.
items.reusable_rule: Reader Notes require identifiable bibliographic sources and professional links; internal aliases and local paths never render.
items.future_check: Fail Notes generation on unresolved, generic, internal or non-public source identity.

items.failure: An interior chart remained after the human chose a text-only interior.
items.root_cause: Useful visual admission was mistaken for a permanent format requirement.
items.reusable_rule: Interior visuals are opt-in per BookSpec and human design decision; zero visuals is valid.
items.future_check: Rendered interior visual count must match the approved BookSpec exactly.
